profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procter & Gamble
profile.summary:
Android Engineer, previous Front-End Engineer. Enjoys creating memorable user experiences for android and the web.

Android skills - App architecture, Activity/Fragments lifecycle, MVVM architecture pattern, intents, jetpack compose, dataBinding, viewBinding, liveData, Room, Retrofit, Moshi, Koin

Web skills - React, Mobx, Redux, AWS, Sass, Node, Express, RESTful APIs, Databases (SQL - PostgreSQL), Cypress, Jest, Git, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)

projects.title: Miami PRIME
projects.description: Miami University's Farmer School of Business summer program, known as the Professional Institute for Management Education (PRIME), has been re-branded for potential students. Our task was to create a promotional plan for PRIME to implement in order to gain more applicants. We created many proposals to be executed throughout the year and PRIME's future including campus advertising, social media posts, and brand ambassador interns.

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Omega
organizations.description: Through Alpha Phi Omega, I am able to volunteer my time and make a difference on my college campus and in the surrounding area.
